about: Distances read by the player on the in-game galaxy map (LJ = Lichtjahre = light years), collected to find how the game places systems inside a region and how many light years one region (voxel) step is. Append new samples; keep the context (galaxy map open?, camera focus) - the gGalacticScale value is the map camera's focus, not necessarily the current system.

known_positions_voxels.note: Exact positions recorded by positions.py (gGalacticScale value, map closed, 30 s in the system): position / 100 in region (voxel) units.

findings: 2026-10-05: all four systems are in one region (-384, 2, -1755): the plugin's region-based distance can only say '< 400 ly' for them.
2026-10-05: system index differences 17, 16, 116 give 19, 24, 58 ly - not monotone, so the system index does not place a system linearly.
2026-10-05: Delta Sol -> Yibrazh is 0.394 voxel by the recorded positions = 158 ly if a voxel is 400 ly. The in-game distance between them would calibrate the scale.

2026-10-05: Delta Sol -> camera focus = 0.628 voxel. If the camera sat on Kayanis / Mibayev / Occultimo, a voxel would be 30 / 38 / 92 ly - inconsistent with each other and with 400, so the focus was probably on none of them (or the map camera has an offset).
2026-10-05: with the map open, gGalacticScale = the selected star's position (Occultimo's value, read from Delta Sol, matched its own value read in the system).

2026-10-05: Delta Sol <-> Occultimo = 0.6281 units = 58 LJ in the game -> 92.3 LJ per unit (one sample). Predictions to check: Delta Sol -> Yibrazh 36 LJ, Occultimo -> Yibrazh 66 LJ, galaxy centre 165,868 LJ (vs 718,503 at 400 LJ/unit).
2026-10-05: a system can lie outside [region, region+1) of its own region (Occultimo y = 1.88 in region y = 2): positions.inside_region is too strict, and region cells are not simply floor(position).
2026-10-05: centre distance 718,470 LJ for Occultimo vs |position| x 400 = 718,503 LJ (0.005 %): one position unit = one region = 400 LJ; the 92.3 LJ/unit estimate is wrong.

2026-10-05: Occultimo -> Yibrazh read 251 LJ = Occultimo -> the plugin's 'Delta Sol' value x 400 (251.2); Occultimo -> plugin's 'Yibrazh' value = 286 LJ. Suspected swap/staleness of recorded positions.

2026-10-05: Delta Sol's position read with the camera locked on it: (-383.6563, 2.2776, -1754.3949). Occultimo -> it = 0.5798 units = 232 LJ at 400 LJ/unit, exactly 4x the 58 LJ read from Delta Sol earlier - unexplained (local distances at 100 LJ/unit? or a misread?).
